message:
Thanks. So far I have: New York, and a household of 2 adults (you and your partner, both in your thirties). To narrow things down, could you tell me:
1. How many children under 18 live with you? (none / 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 or more)
2. Roughly how much does your household earn from work in a year, before tax? (none / $1-10k / $10-20k / $20-30k / $30-40k / $40-50k / $50-60k / $60-80k / $80-100k / $100-150k / $150k+)
reply: None. Somewhere between 300 thousand and 500 thousand a year.

summary: Household in New York: two adults in their thirties, no children under 18, combined work income roughly $300,000-$500,000 a year. Income is far above the limits for all ten programmes. SNAP, WIC, TANF, SSI, Medicaid, CHIP, EITC, the refundable Child Tax Credit, the ACA premium tax credit, and free or reduced-price school meals all look unavailable. No programmes recommended; no caseworker referral needed. Screening was based on the two answers given (children and income). Other answers (assets, housing, disability) were not asked because they would not change the result.
